title: Request Clone
subtitle: On-demand clone of any Git repository by URL.

card.title: Clone repository by URL
card.description: Enter the repository URL, validate access and queue the clone. The job is enqueued with higher priority than the others already in the queue.

url.label: Repository URL
url.hint: Accepts any host (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, self-hosted) via https or git@host:path.
